title: #sarahjessicaparker #matthewbroderick #broadway #plazasuite
transcript: so i was having my morning coffee and reading the reviews of the revival of plaza suite starring sarah jessica parker and matthew Broderick now i should mention i have not seen this revival but i have seen the play a couple of times so i'm familiar with the material and in terms of this particular revival the reviews weren't particularly great but not for the reason i was anticipating and generally the reviews had a problem with the material questioning why are we doing this type of show right now and the reason why that surprised me is because neil simons play is a classic and i just assumed people would be like question the material because it's neil simon it's plaza suite but yeah reviewers for the most part were like what was funny then isn't really that funny now and it reinforces some really harmful tropes about marriage about women and and i particularly found that encouraging that reviewers like the new york times jesse green of all people who wrote that review about tootsie was like no this is not this is not it did you see this production did you read the reviews would you think?
